article.story: BOZEMAN, Mont. -- — Jed Miller scored 27 points as Montana State beat Weber State 91-88 on Saturday night. Miller also had five rebounds for the Bobcats (13-8, 7-1 Big Sky Conference). Christian King scored 20 points while shooting 6 for 11 (4 for 6 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line. Seth Amunrud finished with 13 points. Tijan Saine led the Wildcats (10-11, 4-4) with 24 points and four assists. Viljami Vartiainen and Trevor Henning had 15 points apiece. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
